sovereign_country.strategic_role: 泛欧数字贸易门户、极速低成本在线设立与新锐EMI银行开户

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Export Distribution of Pre-Packaged Spicy Tallow Hotpot Base Bricks

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act (2023 Revision) of the Cayman Islands - general incorporation and Exempted Company provisions (Part V, ss. 55-60) - together with the Tax Concessions Act (2024 Revision), s. 6; supplemented by the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014, Part XXIII (overseas companies) for the Gibraltar distribution branch registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry - Registrar of Companies (CIRIS electronic filing); Gibraltar Companies Registry for overseas branch registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association and Application for Registration; the General Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; the authorised share capital may be USD 1 or such higher amount as the board determines; shares may be issued fully or partly paid; no escrow account or capital deposit is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company be and are hereby adopted. (2) That the subscribers accept the allotment of the initial ordinary shares set out in the register of members. (3) That the registered office be fixed at the address of the licensed corporate services provider. (4) That [NAME] be and is hereby appointed first Director. (5) That the Director be authorized to open a corporate bank account, procure a company seal (if any), and execute documents for registration as an overseas company in Gibraltar. (6) That the Company apply for an exemption undertaking under section 6, Tax Concessions Act (2024 Revision).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Beneficial Owner KYC Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry - CIRIS Corporate E-Filing Portal via the licensed Corporate Services Provider (CSP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select three proposed names (principal plus alternatives) and submit a Name Reservation application through the CSP's activated CIRIS account. Concurrently submit AML/KYC files for each proposed member and director; the CSP validates the ultimate beneficial ownership (UBO) declaration against the statutory registers. Once cleared, the General Registry issues a name approval notice valid for 90 days. Where subscribers are corporate entities, certified extracts and directors' consent letters must accompany the filing.
required_dossiers: Certified copies of passports of all members and directors
Recent utility bill or bank statement for proof of residential address
Source of wealth / source of funds statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects a name for undesirability or similarity with an existing company, resubmit an alternative name list within five business days; rejected names attract no additional statutory fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Cayman Registered Office Provider (Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles of Association incorporating the authorised share capital, director powers, and indemnity provisions. Each subscriber executes the M&A, the consent to act as director, and the registered office notice; signatures are witnessed or notarized according to subscriber nationality requirements, with notarized translations supplied where the subscriber's language is not English.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office acceptance letter from the service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any drafting defect identified by the registered agent or subscriber counsel is cured by a supplemental deed of revision prepared and re-executed within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Submission to the Registrar and Government Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry - Registrar of Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed M&A and the incorporation return via CIRIS; pay the CI 850 government registration fee (USD 1,020) together with CIRIS and agent disbursement fees; obtain the electronic filing receipt referencing the CIN tracking number. Confirm the registered office address and the director's details as recorded in the statutory registers.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Government fee receipt / CIRIS payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar raises a technical requisition on the return, file an amended return within seven calendar days; failure attracts late filing penalties under the Companies (Fees) Regulations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Exemption
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cayman Islands General Registry and the Cayman Tax Information Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Receive the Certificate of Incorporation naming the company as an Exempted Company; immediately thereafter submit the application for a tax exemption undertaking under section 6 of the Tax Concessions Act (2024 Revision), securing an exemption from all taxes imposed under Cayman law for the statutory term currently available to exempted companies. File the registered office certificate and director details with the register.
required_dossiers: Board resolution authorizing the exemption application
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Tax Information Authority will accept the exemption where the Company confirms it carries on no business inside the Cayman Islands and files the prescribed declaration; standard declarations are processed within the service level agreement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Gibraltar Branch Registration as an Overseas Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies Registry - Registrar of Companies (HM Government of Gibraltar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the overseas company registration pack under Part XXIII of the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014, attaching the apostilled Cayman Certificate of Incorporation, certified copy of the M&A, current directors' list, and notice of the Gibraltar registered service address; pay the registration fee of approximately GBP 65; the Registrar issues the Gibraltar Certificate of Registration (branch number).
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
List of directors and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries certification of the Cayman documents, obtain a fresh apostille from the Cayman General Registry (Hague Apostille Convention) and resubmit within fourteen days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Governance, Bank Account Opening and Post-Incorporation Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors, Cayman Registered Agent and Gibraltar Company Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution by written consent of the sole or first director; appoint any additional officers; open a Euro/GBP corporate account with a Gibraltar e-money institution (EMI) or licensed bank; deliver the UBO register and tax declarations to the Gibraltar Financial Intelligence Unit / GFSC as applicable; procure a Certificate of Good Standing from the Cayman registry within thirty days of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Register of Members, Directors and Charges
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EMI requests additional source-of-funds evidence, supply the board-audited sales pipeline and introducing bank letter; if the Certificate of Good Standing is queried, request a countersigned copy through the registered agent or the Gibraltar branch office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Trade, Business and Occupation Licensing Office (Ministry of Business) acting jointly with the Environmental Health Directorate and the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Operator Registration and Cold/Dry Storage Premises Approval (Retained Regulation (EC) No 852/2004) together with the Trade Licence for Wholesale of Seasonings and Sauces

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Gibraltar Environmental Agency (EA) - Department of the Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Tier 2 - EA Registration and Preliminary Environmental Screening; a Full EIA Report is not triggered because the activity is a distribution warehouse below the 20 MW scheduled threshold; an Environmental Screening Opinion is issued within 30 days.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Trade effluent to sewer: BOD5 not exceeding 40 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 60 mg/L, pH 6-10; VOC emissions not exceeding 5 tonnes per annum per facility; F-Gas leakage monitoring per Regulation (EU) No 517/2014; food waste segregated to licensed collectors under the Waste Management Ordinance 2004; noise limits not exceeding 55 dB(A) at the nearest sensitive receptor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service evidencing compliance with the Fire Safety Act 1985 (fire detection and suppression, two means of escape, PA alarm); Building Control structural load clearance for racking, cold rooms, and mezzanine floors; Health and Safety at Work clearance from the Gibraltar Safety at Work Inspectorate covering PPE, forklift operator permits, and first aid provision.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, Income Tax Office, HM Government of Gibraltar (155 Queensway, Gibraltar GX11 1AA); online portal: www.gibraltar.gov.gi; company registration: Gibraltar Companies Registry (Companies Act 2014); customs: HM Customs Gibraltar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: register the Cayman Exempted Company with the Gibraltar Companies Registry as an overseas company (Form OR1) if a branch or establishment is opened. Step 2: apply to the Income Tax Office for a Gibraltar TIN with the Cayman certificate of incorporation, constitutive documents, good-standing certificate and director/beneficial-owner schedule. Step 3: register with HM Customs Gibraltar as an approved importer/exporter for goods movements. Step 4: file annual returns if Gibraltar-source income arises; a non-resident company without a Gibraltar PE or Gibraltar-source profits has no filing obligation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone with Territorial_Scope: a Cayman Exempted Company is outside all Cayman direct taxes and, while not centrally managed and controlled in Gibraltar and without a Gibraltar permanent establishment, its offshore export-distribution profits are not chargeable in Gibraltar. Entity-level Gibraltar taxation at the 10% standard corporate rate applies only to profits accruing in or derived from Gibraltar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar does not provide check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections. Available elections under the Income Tax Act 2010 are group relief (75% group), roll-over relief on replacement business assets, capital-allowance pooling and the closed-grandfathering terms for historical Gibraltar exempt companies. The Commissioner of Income Tax may issue binding advance rulings on residence, source and permanent establishment, and the Cayman-side statutory tax undertaking preserves the exempted-company status at home.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST - Gibraltar applies a duty-based indirect tax regime (Customs Duties Ordinance, excise duty and Purchase Tax Ordinance). Exports and goods in transit are duty-free, and pre-packaged foodstuffs for re-export are generally outside the purchase tax schedule.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no VAT/GST turnover threshold exists; under the duty-based regime an importer/exporter must register with HM Customs Gibraltar from the first goods movement (nil monetary threshold). Thresholds are expressed in Gibraltar Pounds (GIP), at parity with GBP; purchase tax arises only on scheduled imported goods and is not turnover-thresholded.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API e-invoicing or digital stamping mandate exists in Gibraltar. Customs clearance is effected through electronic SAD/goods declarations lodged with HM Customs Gibraltar, with release after duty/purchase-tax settlement; commercial PDF/EDI e-invoicing is accepted, and e-records of invoices, Bills of Lading and remittance evidence must be retained for audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - Gibraltar has no VAT/GST, so no export zero-rating claim or input-tax refund mechanism arises; exports are outside the charge by statutory operation. Direct-tax counterpart: non-resident companies are not taxed on foreign-source export profits provided contract conclusion, central management and control, and title/risk transfer sit outside Gibraltar, with arm's-length pricing and a complete invoice-remittance trail duly documented.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Gibraltar Customs Export Declaration (electronic SAD/goods declaration)
Bill of Lading or Sea Waybill (or Air Waybill for air cargo)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/MT103 evidence of export proceeds
Certificate of Origin (non-preferential or preferential under UK/EU arrangements where claimed)
Export licence and food safety certificate / certificate of free sale for pre-packaged foodstuffs (ISIC 4638)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Audit scrutiny focuses on connected-party export pricing, source and PE mapping, purchase-tax exclusion and export duty-free status; export-proceeds documentation must be assembled within the 180-day evidence window (no Gibraltar FX-repatriation statute exists, but the 180-day protocol governs substance records). Under the Income Tax Act 2010, negligent or fraudulent returns attract extended assessments and penalties up to 100% to 150% of undercharged tax, with possible prosecution; customs false declarations warrant forfeiture, fines up to treble goods value and revocation of trading authorisations. Retrospective clawback applies with interest where territorial exemption, purchase-tax exclusion or export duty-freedom is abused, and stop-notices may be issued on outward consignments.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of the Company (Form 64) and Annual Fee Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Companies Registry (under GFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of the company's incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of GBP 50 (approx USD 60) per day up to a maximum of GBP 500; continued default for 3 months triggers administrative strike-off by the Registrar and additional restoration costs.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (nil return or updated register)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Beneficial Ownership Register, Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the same date as the Annual Return; must be confirmed within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal liability for each defaulting officer with fines up to GBP 5,000 (approx USD 6,100); the company may also be removed from the register in cases of repeated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Audited Financial Statements (if audit threshold exceeded)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Gibraltar Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 9 months after the end of the accounting reference period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors liable to fines up to GBP 5,000 (approx USD 6,100) and potential disqualification; late filing may trigger separate penalty notices from the Registry.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renewal of Business License for Food Export Distribution (under Import/Export Regulations)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Customs Department and Environmental Health Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of initial license issuance; must be renewed before 31 December for the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Suspension of the license, immediate cessation of trading activity, and monetary fines up to GBP 10,000 (approx USD 12,200) for continued unlicensed operation.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Companies meeting any two of the following three criteria must undergo a statutory audit: (i) annual turnover exceeding Gibraltar Pounds 6.5 million (approx USD 8.2 million); (ii) balance sheet total exceeding Gibraltar Pounds 3.26 million (approx USD 4.1 million); (iii) average number of employees exceeding 50. A 'qualifying company' under the Income Tax (Qualifying Companies) Regulations may be exempt from audit if it holds a valid certificate and fulfills the prescribed conditions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the EU and incorporated into Gibraltar law for public interest and large entities; other companies may apply Gibraltar GAAP (based on UK FRS 102) for non-public accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register and annually confirm the accuracy of the information on the register by filing a confirmation statement with the Registrar of Companies. Any changes to beneficial ownership occurring during the year must be filed within 14 days. The annual confirmation is due at the same time as the Annual Return, and a nil-return is permitted if no changes have occurred.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 10% rate on the first GBP 100,000 of chargeable profits; no general statutory tax holidays; grandfathered exempt-company status abolished under the 2010 income tax reform
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carry-forward of trading losses against future trading profits of the same trade; carry-back generally unavailable except upon cessation)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Company Income Tax Return (Form CT1 - 'Return of Income - Company') filed through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office e-filing portal at https://www.tax.gov.gi
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return and final tax payment due within 12 months after the end of the accounting period; for a 31 December year-end, due by the following 31 December; interim payments on account of 50% of the prior-year liability are payable on 30 June and 31 December where the prior-year liability exceeded GBP 2,500

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification: legal name, Gibraltar company or overseas company registration number, and tax file reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Cayman registration number (ELF 549300KY_EX) and the Gibraltar overseas company registration number if registered under Part 22 of the Companies Act 2014

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period: start and end dates of the chargeable period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the 12-month period; a non-resident with a short-period branch account must pro-rate the period and attach an explanatory note

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross trading receipts from the export distribution of pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot soup base bricks
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only Gibraltar-source trading receipts allocated to the Gibraltar permanent establishment; exclude income sourced in Cayman or other territories if separately traceable

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Other income: dividend income, bank interest, currency exchange gains on Swift-TT and letter-of-credit settlement flows
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest economically connected to the Gibraltar distribution business is Gibraltar-source and taxable; no remittance basis applies to non-resident companies
Compute gross income using the same basis as residents; no exemption is available merely because ownership is held by a Cayman Exempted Company

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible expenses: procurement cost of soup base bricks, freight, insurance, customs duties, packaging, warehousing, and documented management fees
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be incurred wholly and exclusively for the Gibraltar PE trade; intra-group service charges must satisfy the arm's-length standard and be supported by service agreements

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable profits before loss relief (Box 5 - Box 6)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the transfer pricing adjustment if the PE profit allocation departs from the approved OECD method (TNMM or profit split)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss relief claimed: prior trading losses carried forward
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses must arise from the same trade and cannot be surrendered between related entities without a valid Gibraltar group election
If nil, attach full audited accounts and a reconciliation statement to preempt a deemed-profit assessment by the Commissioner

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax at 10% on the first GBP 100,000 of assessable income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The 10% band applies to all companies, including non-resident PEs; it is not restricted to locally owned firms

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax at 12.5% on assessable income exceeding GBP 100,000
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No additional surcharge for non-residents; however, non-filing activates the Commissioner's default assessment powers with penalty exposure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total corporate income tax liability (Box 10 + Box 11)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign tax credit on inbound income is claimed here only where a unilateral credit applies; attach Form TCC-1 with evidence of foreign tax paid

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payments on account and tax deducted at source already paid
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory payments on account are due on 30 June and 31 December; payment references must include the company's Gibraltar tax file number

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of tax payable or refund due
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Settle via a Gibraltar-licensed bank or EMI using Swift-TT; attach proof of settlement to the filing record

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs an initial fixed penalty of GBP 250 plus GBP 60 per calendar day of continuing default, capped at GBP 6,000; understatement of tax attracts an additional penalty of up to 100% of the tax understated; late payment accrues interest at the statutory rate of 5% per annum from the due date

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Gibraltar imposes no withholding tax on dividends, whether paid to residents or non-residents
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Gibraltar has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; therefore no DTA withholding-rate reduction or tax-residence-certificate pathway exists for outbound Gibraltar dividends. A Cayman Exempted Company may apply to the Gibraltar Commissioner of Income Tax for a Certificate of Tax Residence to evidence status for foreign authorities where the investor jurisdiction requires proof of Gibraltarian residence. Where foreign withholding tax is suffered on inbound income, unilateral foreign tax credit relief is claimed by attaching Form TCC-1 (Foreign Tax Credit Claim) to Form CT1, supported by certified evidence of foreign tax paid; the credit is limited to the Gibraltar tax attributable to the same income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Outbound royalties and interest: Gibraltar statutory withholding rate 0%; no DTA treaty rates apply. Inbound royalties and interest received from Cayman are not subject to Cayman withholding tax as Cayman imposes no such tax. Payments of interest on intercompany debt funding the hotpot soup base distribution activity are deductible in Gibraltar only if arm's-length and not thinly capitalised

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File where aggregate inter-company transactions exceed GBP 1,000,000 per accounting period; mandatory Master File where the worldwide group's consolidated revenue exceeds GBP 50,000,000; Country-by-Country report required where group turnover exceeds EUR 750,000,000
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The OECD/EU-aligned Gibraltar Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) 2019 fully apply. The export distribution of pre-packaged spicy tallow hotpot soup base bricks constitutes 'Distribution and Service Centre Business' for the purposes of the ESR. The Exempted Company must demonstrate that core income-generating activities - contract negotiation, stock management, invoicing, and logistics control - are performed in Gibraltar with adequate physical premises, qualified personnel, and operating expenditure proportionate to the income stream. Annual ESR notification and substance reporting are mandatory. As the entity is also a Cayman Exempted Company, Cayman-side Economic Substance Law reporting obligations continue concurrently; tax residence in Gibraltar discharges Cayman ESR obligations if evidenced properly, but both annual filings must be made to avoid dual penalties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of Gibraltar-source distribution profits from Form CT1; issuance of artificial inter-company invoices to divert profits to offshore accounts; destruction or concealment of trading records for the hotpot soup base export business
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded plus interest; criminal conviction on indictment attracts a fine of up to GBP 100,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 7 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The Gibraltar Supreme Court may impose travel bans and worldwide asset-freezing orders against directors; directors who knowingly participate in the evasion are personally liable for the unpaid tax, interest and penalties, and may be disqualified from acting as directors for up to 15 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Non-Compliance with Economic Substance Requirements
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Cayman Exempted Company as a letterbox entity with no physical presence or personnel in either Gibraltar or Cayman, while deriving distribution profits sourced in Gibraltar and failing to file annual ESR notifications or substance reports
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Gibraltar ESR penalty: fine up to GBP 100,000 for failure to file the substance report or provide information, with a continuing daily penalty of up to GBP 1,000; Cayman ESR: fixed penalty of KYD 10,000, increased to KYD 20,000 for continuing default, and possible strike-off of the company from the Cayman registry
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal restitution orders where the registered office is used without genuine control; the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission may apply for disqualification, personal liability for regulatory fines, and revocation of trading permission; false statements in substance declarations are a criminal offence punishable by imprisonment

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging a non-arm's-length mark-up on inter-company exports of the pre-packaged hotpot soup base bricks to a related Cayman trading arm; failure to prepare contemporaneous Local File documentation; absence of a benchmark study for the wholesale distribution function
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compensating tax adjustment at 12.5% on re-determined profits, plus interest from the original due date and a penalty of up to 100% of the additional tax; the Commissioner may also substitute a deemed profit based on a TNMM margin applicable to wholesale distribution of foodstuffs
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where a transfer pricing adjustment renders the company insolvent, directors face wrongful trading liability under the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014, including personal liability for tax claims and disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing hotpot soup base export settlement payments through the target payment rails (Swift-TT and Letters of Credit) without conducting customer due diligence; failure to file Suspicious Activity Reports on unusually structured payments routed through the Gibraltar EMI account; provision of false information to the licensed financial institution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 (Gibraltar), conviction on indictment carries imprisonment of up to 14 years and/or an unlimited fine; the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission may impose administrative penalties of up to GBP 100,000 per breach and revoke the entity's registration or the EMI's permission
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors qualify as 'relevant persons' for AML purposes; individual prosecutions may result in imprisonment, confiscation orders over personal assets, and travel bans pending extradition within the British Overseas Territories enforcement network
